messages:
Lina Park: quick UX note 1 I bumped into a layout edge on Dashboard: the action bar's compact variant makes the icon button sit too close to the badge at 375px. screenshot attached.
Ethan Moore: I saw that too. We introduced spacing.condensed recently; maybe its too aggressive for components with inline icons.
Priya Patel: suggestion: keep spacing.condensed for layout, but add component tokens: button.spacing-condensed = 10px; button.icon-spacing = 10px. That keeps semantics local.
Samir Khan: dev side: fine with component tokens. prefer css variables like --btn-gap-condensed and --btn-vertical-pad to avoid global token churn. Will add migration comments.
Lina Park: another thing  toasts on Integrations are overlapping the onboarding modal title when an event fires. Looks like layer ordering is inconsistent between apps.
Ethan Moore: current layers are numeric constants. can we swap to semantic layers: surface.toast, surface.modal, surface.header and map them per app at runtime? avoids hard numeric swaps.
Priya Patel: copy tweak: product wants smaller toast CTA copy e.g., "Undo" / "View" instead of longer phrases. keep action terse for scannability.
Samir Khan: quick patch draft I pushed: github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/418 -- introduces variables and a small CSS fix. snippet below:

```css
:root { --btn-gap-condensed: 10px; --btn-pad-vertical: 6px; --layer-surface-toast: 1200; --layer-surface-modal: 1100; }
.button--condensed { padding: var(--btn-pad-vertical) 12px; gap: var(--btn-gap-condensed); min-width: 44px; }
.toast { z-index: var(--layer-surface-toast); right: 16px; bottom: 16px; }
.modal { z-index: var(--layer-surface-modal); }
```

Samir Khan: also added a flag to stack toasts under 420px: .toast-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
accessibility-bot: a11y check: ensure icon-only buttons have aria-label, add :focus-visible outline, validate 44px hit target, and toasts use aria-live for non-critical messages.
Priya Patel: good call. Add that checklist to the component PR template please. Also, tooltips for icon buttons should not surface token names (e.g., spacing.condensed). Use user-facing copy.
Lina Park: agreed. One more tiny visual ask: increase modal title z-offset shadow so a short toast doesn't visually collide on small screens. But only if it doesn't create depth conflicts.
Ethan Moore: will run visual diffs on the patch branch and post screenshots. If diffs are trivial, we can include token docs + migration note.
Samir Khan: pushing updated branch now with tests and checklist. ping me for review if you want quick tweaks.
Lina Park: thanks everyone  scheduling a 10 min sync after standup to finalize token names and copy. /remind in 10
accessibility-bot: Reminder scheduled for Lina Park in 10 minutes.
